dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The primary dorsal midline features three distinct 'O' shaped rings with sharp light-grey perimeters enclosing dark interior cores. The lateral regions display several semi-closed 'C' shaped arcs with consistent pixel-width boundaries and high contrast against the dark exterior coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of high-intensity, non-gradient pixel clusters; primary concentrations are observed at the anterior neck transition and as isolated nodes within the lateral reticulated network.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary dorsal annuli form a nearly linear longitudinal axis. Extending connections to the centroids of the lateral 'C' structures defines a series of interconnected scalene triangles and irregular quadrilaterals across the torso.
